changelog:
- Initial release supporting end-to-end deployment of the NewAPI LLM Gateway on Huawei Cloud via Terraform.
- Provides unified LLM API gateway for multi-model management, load balancing, key rotation, and usage statistics.
- Secure handling of sensitive credentials (AK/SK)—never exposed in chat or output; user must edit configuration files manually if needed.
- Step-by-step workflow guidance, including extraction of solution info, template normalization, variable confirmation, deployment, verification, and cleanup.
- Explicit user confirmation required before deploying or destroying resources.
- Outputs and verification processes are standardized in JSON format for clarity and automation.
